title: inline after complete
rule: Prefer inline validation after the user finishes a field; do not show an error before input is complete or on fields they have not reached.

citation.source: NN/g — 10 Design Guidelines for Reporting Errors in Forms (§1, §7)

pass_when: Field error can appear after the user finishes that field (blur/complete), without a full-form submit as the only path; no error while still typing that field; untouched later fields stay quiet.
fail_when: Errors only after full submit; or error appears mid-keystroke on the active field; or untouched fields are marked invalid.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
